visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera points downward at a person's legs dressed in black pants and green rubber boots, walking through thick, watery grey mud that covers the ground entirely. (2) The scene transitions to an outdoor disaster relief site where several people in dark work clothes and masks are using shovels to move large mounds of wet grey silt. The setting is bright and sunny, with green mountains and trees visible under a clear blue sky. (3) A group of soldiers wearing green camouflage uniforms and masks walk in formation down a road covered in dried mud and debris, passing under utility lines. (4) A massive, colorful pile of discarded rubber boots is shown on a sidewalk next to a building, followed by a shot of dozens of shovels with various handle types neatly organized against a metal railing. (5) Volunteers in reflective vests are seen handing out supplies, including bottled water and food boxes, to a crowd of people. A long row of white and grey portable toilets is lined up along a paved street nearby. (6) A man wearing a black shirt, a grey hat, and a pink mask demonstrates how to shovel mud efficiently by using his leg to push down on a red-handled shovel. Behind him, the tiled roof of a damaged building sits low to the ground. (7) The video concludes with a wide shot of a large crowd consisting of soldiers and civilians who are clapping their hands and cheering in front of a local bakery shop with a red sign.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 到花蓮光復鄉幫忙需要準備什麼？ (2) [Subtitle]: 最重要的就是防曬跟口罩. (3) [Subtitle]: 你會有很長的時間在大太陽底下. (4) [Subtitle]: 更換地點清除淤泥. (5) [Subtitle]: 而沿路不論室內外都是塵土飛揚. (6) [Subtitle]: 所以排汗短袖、袖套、漁夫帽、長褲以及口罩這些是最重要的. (7) [Subtitle]: 雨鞋我是自己買過去. (8) [Subtitle]: 不過車站前已經有之前的志工留下堆成山的雨鞋了. (9) [Subtitle]: 你可以現場挑一雙合腳的. (10) [Subtitle]: 另外現場也不缺鏟子. (11) [Subtitle]: 尖頭、平頭的都有. (12) [Subtitle]: 從一出車站到目前最嚴重的佛祖街. (13) [Subtitle]: 沿路都會有推車、水桶跟鏟子. (14) [Subtitle]: 一路上也都會有志工發放瓶裝水、運動飲料. (15) [Subtitle]: 便當、炒麵、點心、口罩、毛巾、護目鏡. (16) [Subtitle]: 到處都有流動廁所. (17) [Subtitle]: 所以吃的、喝的、用的都不需要自己準備. (18) [Subtitle]: 你只需要把自己照顧好. (19) [Subtitle]: 防曬做好，時常補充水分. (20) [Subtitle]: 該休息該換手的時候都會有人跟你輪. (21) [Subtitle]: 最後記得在用鏟子的時候. (22) [Subtitle]: 一定要善用自己的體重跟鏟子的槓桿. (23) [Subtitle]: 不然在大太陽底下體力會流失很快. (24) [Variety]: 加油！辛苦你們了. [Logo]: @美香齋餅店.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with the wet, squelching sounds of footsteps in thick mud, layered with a calm male narrator speaking in Mandarin. An acoustic guitar with a simple, bright strumming pattern provides a steady background rhythm. (2) A transient metal 'clink' and 'scrape' sound occurs as shovels dig into the earth, mixed with the narrator's consistent conversational pitch. The ambient outdoor wind noise is low. (3) The acoustic texture shifts slightly as background chatter from multiple voices increases, accompanied by the rustling of cardboard boxes and plastic water bottles being handled. (4) A percussive 'thud' is heard as a shovel is pressed into the mud using a foot. The narration ends with a final instruction, leading into a sudden swell of crowd noise. (5) The final phase is dominated by a loud, high-arousal chorus of multiple people clapping rhythmically and shouting 'Jia You' (Go!) in unison, creating a high-energy celebratory acoustic environment.
